meta.name: Nobody Wants This
meta.description:
An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love, but can their relationship survive their wildly different lives and meddling families?

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 26 Sept 2024 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: 3 Arts Entertainment, Steven Levitan Prods, 20th Television · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 10/10

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Fresh off another unsuccessful date, Joanne sashays into a friend's party and meets Noah, an adorable rabbi who recently broke up with his girlfriend.

videos.title: A Shiksa Walks Into a Temple
videos.overview: Joanne and Noah get to know each other, but reality hits when she learns about his romantic history and he deals with an interrogation from his family.

videos.title: Either Aura
videos.overview: A podcast pile-on about her aura and an unanswered text make Joanne question if she's a good match for Noah, who faces a guilt trip after an accident.

videos.title: Obliterated
videos.overview: Joanne's last-minute dash to pick up a sex toy for a podcast episode makes for a memorable first date with Noah. Sasha helps Miriam with a boy problem.

videos.title: My Friend Joanne
videos.overview: Work obligations interfere with Noah and Joanne's plans to take their relationship to the next level, while Sasha and Morgan bond over family dynamics.

videos.title: The Ick
videos.overview: During an impromptu get-together with Joanne's family, Noah is determined to make a good impression — so determined that it's a major turnoff.

videos.title: WAGS
videos.overview: Meeting Joanne's friends? Easy enough for Noah. But winning over his pals means making nice with their wives and girlfriends, who are close to his ex.

videos.title: Rebecca's Box
videos.overview: Joanne's discovery of a small box in Noah's bedroom turns into something much bigger as she fights the urge to snoop, and he receives big news at work.

videos.title: My Girl Bina
videos.overview: Power games and a custom-made charcuterie board complicate Joanne's official introduction to Noah's parents. Morgan asks Sasha for a favor.

videos.title: Bat Mitzvah Crashers
videos.overview: Miriam's Big Apple-themed bat mitzvah sets the scene for even greater life changes when Noah and Joanne confront questions about their future.

videos.title: Dinner Party
videos.overview: Riding high on romance, Joanne and Noah merge their friend groups at a dinner party. But an offhand comment reveals they're not quite on the same page.

videos.title: Leave It at the Tree
videos.overview: When Joanne nudges Noah to express his feelings, he surprises even himself. Morgan's request for constructive feedback quickly devolves into blowback.

videos.title: The Unethical Therapist
videos.overview: An unlikely guest stirs things up on the podcast. Morgan's polarizing plus-one raises eyebrows at a party. Bina gets pushy with Sasha and Esther.

videos.title: Valentine's Day
videos.overview: When Noah cooks up a swoon-worthy Valentine's plan, Joanne worries about his true intentions — and the price of setting aside her own traditions.

videos.title: Abby Loves Smoothies
videos.overview: Intending to support Noah at a baby-naming ceremony, Joanne can't resist teaming up with Morgan for some payback against a former rival.

videos.title: Anything Can Happen
videos.overview: Still reeling from Noah's request for a "night off" from her, Joanne tries to keep it together as her parents meet his for the first time.

videos.title: When You Know, You Know
videos.overview: A blunder on an important shopping trip sets off fireworks on the podcast. Noah's modern new workplace delivers some old-fashioned culture shock.

videos.title: A Better Rabbi
videos.overview: Noah guides a surprisingly experienced new student. Joanne faces mounting pressure. Morgan recruits Sasha to dig up some digital dirt.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: An afternoon couples' hang goes off the rails when a provocative party game reveals everyone's most uncomfortable truths.

videos.title: When Noah Met Joanne
videos.overview: The complexities of love get all too real at a lavish celebration, as Joanne and Noah question what's worth holding onto — and what's slipping away.

videos.title: It's Perfect
videos.overview: Joanne and Noah celebrate moving in together — and discover each other's annoying household habits.

videos.title: Daddy's Home
videos.overview: As Noah makes another go at his dream job, Joanne goes to extremes — and Judaism class — to shift the narrative about the couple's relationship.

videos.title: Housewarming
videos.overview: Joanne and Noah plan the perfect Jewish housewarming, but Joanne's efforts to impress a callous ex-boyfriend invite awkwardness to the party.

videos.title: Brian's Wedding
videos.overview: En route to wine country, Joanne and Noah meet a messy podcast superfan who reminds Joanne of her younger self — and threatens to derail their weekend.

videos.title: The Love Card
videos.overview: A newly friendly Bina extends a dinner invite to Joanne, but there's an ulterior motive at play. Sasha and Esther jump into the dating pool.

videos.title: Heatwave
videos.overview: With temperatures soaring, Joanne and Noah's house becomes an unexpected hot spot — and saying "no" to friends and relatives is making them sweat.

videos.title: Watch What Happens
videos.overview: A talk show brings Morgan and Sasha to New York, where a magical night out threatens to complicate their friendship. Noah and Joanne unplug for Shabbat.

videos.title: One in a Million
videos.overview: The fallout from their trip leaves Sasha and Morgan more confused than ever. Noah struggles to set boundaries with an overbearing Bina.

videos.title: Last Christmas
videos.overview: As Joanne is visited by ghosts of Christmas past, Noah vows to make her final pre-conversion holiday the jolliest yet.

videos.title: The Plunge
videos.overview: Emotions run high and shocking secrets are spilled as Joanne and Noah's families gather for a beachy conversion ceremony.
